VIRTUAL COACHING
Experience a revolutionary approach to achieving your fitness goals with Jamie – your personal fitness trainer, right in the palm of your hand. Our AI workout technology is designed to provide you with unparalleled guidance and motivation, all within the comfort of your home. Workout at your home anytime!

We understand that motivation is key to success and that is why our AI fitness coach app offers engaging and interactive training sessions that will keep you excited about your workouts. No more mindless repetitions – our app makes exercising fun and enjoyable!

AI WORKOUTS
Our AI workout planner adapts to your fitness level, preferences, and goals, crafting personalized workout plans that evolve with you. Never mind if you are a beginner or a seasoned athlete, our app creates workouts personalized to your needs, maximizing the effectiveness of every session.

REAL-TIME MOVEMENT ANALYSIS
Our app provides real-time movement analysis, with instant feedback on your form and technique. This ensures that you're not just working hard but working smart, reducing the risk of injury and optimizing your results.

SEAMLESS INTEGRATION
Our goal is to make your fitness journey as smooth as possible. Jamie seamlessly integrates with your daily routine, allowing you to schedule workouts at your convenience. Whether you have five minutes or an hour to spare, our personalized workout plans can fit into your busy lifestyle.

PERSONALIZED WORKOUT PLANS
No two bodies are the same, and your workout plan shouldn't be either. Our AI workout planner takes into account your individual fitness goals, current fitness level, and equipment availability to curate a workout plan that's just right for you! From weight loss to muscle gain, Jamie has got you covered.

NATURAL TEXT MEAL LOGGING Stay on top of your nutrition effortlessly with our natural text messaging feature. Simply describe your meals in your own words, and Jamie will log them for you. No more tedious data entry—just easy, intuitive meal tracking to complement your fitness journey

DIVERSIFY YOUR FITNESS EXPERIENCE - TRY THESE WORKOUTS:
- HIIT: Burn calories fast with high-intensity interval training. Boost metabolism and endurance for quick, efficient results.
- Yoga: Find inner peace while enhancing flexibility and strength. Yoga improves posture and reduces stress, benefiting both body and mind.
- Core: Strengthen your core muscles for better balance and stability. A solid core leads to improved posture and reduced risk of injury.
- Dance: Shake it off with dance workouts! Enjoy cardio, coordination, and mood-enhancing benefits while having a blast.

- Pilates: Sculpt and tone your body with Pilates. Enhance flexibility, posture, and core strength for a leaner, more toned physique.
- Kids Workouts: Keep your little ones active and healthy with our specially designed kids' section. Fun and engaging workouts tailored to their age group, promoting physical fitness and coordination while having loads of fun!


Download our app and embark on the revolutionary fitness journey - Experience the power of AI-driven home workouts! Unlock your true fitness potential – Your transformation starts now!

record.name: ShapeDate: AI Fitness Forecast
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Know the exact date you’ll reach your goal body. ShapeDate uses body-composition modeling and AI to calculate a prediction transformation timeline. Instead of vague targets, you get a specific calendar date based on your current state, your end goal, and your chosen pace.

How It Works:
1. Tell us your goal in plain language. ("Look like Chris Hemsworth")
2. AI analyzes your lean mass, fat mass, and daily energy burn.
3. Receive your ShapeDate—the projected date you’ll reach your target. (for free)
4. Follow daily meal and workout plans tailored to your body and routine.

Core Features:
• Receive your unique ShapeDate based on body composition and metabolic data
• AI goal processing that interprets natural-language targets
• Tracking for fat mass, lean mass, and weight trends
• Meal plans built from foods and restaurants you already prefer
• Custom workouts for the specific equipment you have access to
• AI assistant for adjustments, questions, and daily guidance
• Progress calendar that updates projections based on adherence
• Adjustable pacing with automatic recalculation

Science:
ShapeDate factors in BMR, TDEE, lean mass, fat mass, calorie targets, and macro needs. Calculations adapt to cutting, bulking, or recomposition goals and adjust as your data changes.

Personalization:
Supports different eating styles, food preferences, allergies, and equipment limits. Learns your habits, update plans automatically, and adapt when your routine shifts.

Subscription:
ShapeDate offers a premium subscription for full access to AI-generated plans and guidance.
The payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase. Subscription renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in Apple ID account settings.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:
ShapeDate provides AI-powered fitness coaching for informational and educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. 
Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before starting any diet or exercise program. Individual results may vary based on factors including starting point, adherence, and genetics. The calorie and macro calculations are estimates based on established formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor, body composition research) and should be used as general guidance only.

Privacy Policy: https://www.shapedate.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.shapedate.ai/terms-of-service

Budy is your AI fitness coach for training, nutrition, progress, and consistency. It builds a personalized plan around your goals, schedule, equipment, experience level, health notes, and real progress.

Whether you want to build muscle, lose fat, get stronger, improve endurance, move more, or rebuild consistency, Budy gives you more than a workout list. It gives you a complete fitness system that helps you train smarter, eat with purpose, track what matters, and keep going.

AI TRAINING PLANS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Tell Budy where you train: home, gym, outdoors, or hybrid. Add your weekly schedule, available equipment, experience, injuries or limitations, and preferred commitment style: Aggressive, Balanced, or Relaxed. Budy creates a realistic plan built around you.

ADAPTIVE WORKOUTS
Your plan is not static. Budy updates around your progress, recovery, schedule, equipment, and training location. If you miss a session, need a lighter day, or train somewhere else, Budy helps you stay moving without losing momentum.

FOCUSED WORKOUT TRACKING
Follow exercise video demos, track sets, reps, weight, time, and rest, log notes, and see last-time performance. Budy also supports advanced training styles like supersets, drop sets, cluster sets, and rest-pause work.

SMART EXERCISE SWAPS
Need a different movement? Swap exercises when equipment, space, or comfort changes. Budy suggests alternatives that still match the intent of your plan.

AI COACH
Ask Budy about training, recovery, plateaus, rest days, nutrition, missed workouts, or schedule changes. Your AI Coach gives personalized guidance based on your plan, goals, progress, and recent activity.

NUTRITION BUILT AROUND YOUR GOAL
Set your diet style, allergies, ingredient preferences, cuisines, meal timing, and nutrition targets. Track calories and macros, get smart meal suggestions, view meal history, and discover food ideas that support your training.

MEAL PHOTO ANALYSIS
Take a photo of your meal and Budy can estimate calories, protein, carbs, and fat, then add the estimate to your daily nutrition progress. Manual logging is available when you want exact numbers.

Turn on voice guidance to stay focused through exercise transitions, rest periods, and session flow. Download supported workout videos and audio for offline use, then sync progress when you are back online.

APPLE HEALTH SYNC
Connect Apple Health to sync workouts, steps, heart rate, sleep, and calories for a more complete picture of your fitness.

Standard includes personalized workout plans, adaptive training, exercise demos, smart swaps, workout tracking, progress insights, progress photos, gamification, reminders, Apple Health sync, and workout history.

record.name: Setune: AI Fitness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
You do the training. Setune figures out what comes next.

Setune is an AI workout coach that actually knows your training. It reads your goals, preferences, and every workout you complete, then plans your next session—changes you can see, reasons you can ask for. Strength comes first; cardio fits in the same plan.

■ A CONVERSATION ABOUT YOUR TRAINING
“I want to squat 100 kg, but my recent sessions have felt tough.” Share your goals and how training feels in your own words, and ask follow-ups anytime. Not sure about the equipment at your gym? Send your coach up to six photos at once to ask how to use it, what to train, or to plan today’s workout around only that equipment.

■ PLAN TOGETHER. UNDERSTAND WHY.
Discuss exercises, sets, and intensity around your goals and preferences, and see why each exercise was chosen and what to focus on. Supersets, circuits, and treadmill incline and speed targets all fit into a plan, and supported changes become a workout you can open and follow in the app.

■ SEE YOUR PROGRESS IN CHARTS
Ask your coach about recent training volume, the body parts you train most, or how one exercise’s strength has changed, and the reply can include a chart drawn from your local records. Stats shows weekly trends and body-part balance, exercise rows show estimated 1RM trends, and every exercise keeps a session-by-session history.

■ GOALS, PREFERENCES, AND LIMITS, REMEMBERED
Goals can have deadlines and progress readings, and your coach brings up overdue ones. Ask to swap an exercise or shorten a session anytime. Coming back after time off? Your next workout eases you back in. Tell your coach about pain, an injury, or feeling unwell, and it keeps a temporary limit with a review date that later plans take into account.

■ LEARN THE MOVEMENT. FOCUS ON EACH SET.
The exercise library has demonstrations and guidance, and you can add your own, including cardio. Log weights, reps, and sets, and use rest timers.

■ YOUR WORKOUT, ALSO ON YOUR WRIST
Add the optional Apple Watch app to view workouts, log sets, and time your rest, then see heart rate and active energy on iPhone; with Apple Health permission, workouts recorded on Apple Watch are saved to Health. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your training heatmap, and Siri and Shortcuts can open your coach or current workout.

■ MAKE YOUR TRAINING HISTORY YOURS
Personalize your profile card with stickers and training-streak milestones. Your plans, records, and training context stay on your devices, and you can export a backup or move to a new phone. Switching supported AI services does not mean rebuilding your workout history.

■ SUBSCRIPTION AND AI
Training features require a monthly or annual auto-renewable Setune subscription. Eligible new subscribers can receive a one-month free trial. Prices and eligibility are shown in the App Store purchase sheet. Without a subscription, you can still read existing workout history and manage privacy and personal data.

You choose your AI source; AI access is not included with Setune. On devices that support Apple Intelligence, use Apple's on-device model with no account or API key: simple questions and reads of your saved records work offline, while more complex tasks such as generating a workout plan run through Apple's Private Cloud Compute and need a network connection. Apple's on-device AI requires supported hardware, software, language, and an available system model. Optional third-party AI services may require their own account, setup, and fees. Photos work with Apple Intelligence or a third-party model that supports images. Model capabilities and availability vary. Before you use remote AI, Setune explains what will be sent to the selected service and asks for consent.

Setune does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. AI suggestions may be inaccurate; use your own judgment.

Privacy Policy: https://gnayiab.app/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

record.name: AWOD: AI Workout Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AWOD is a workout coach that trains with you. It writes your weekly plan, then talks you through each session between sets, on iPhone and Apple Watch.
Your first coached session is free. AWOD Pro adds the voice coach to every workout.

Answer six questions and AWOD builds your week. Open the app and today's session is already there, sized to the time you have and the place you are training.

LIVE VOICE COACH

• A coach in your ear. Before each set it tells you the target, during the set it keeps you honest with short cues, and after you log it tells you what comes next. It stays quiet while you work.
• Talk back during rest. Tap once and ask: "Is this too heavy?" "Can I swap this?" It answers, then gets out of the way.
• Heart rate from Apple Watch. The coach sees your zone and tells you when to push and when to hold.
• Your first coached session includes 30 minutes of voice. Pro includes 300 minutes a month.

WHAT ELSE IT DOES

• A program, not a blank page. Your goal, how often you train, how long you have, gym or home, and any joint you are working around. The program follows from that.
• An AI coach you can text. "I only have 20 minutes." "My shoulder is sore." The coach proposes the change on a card, you tap to apply it, and you can undo it. Nothing changes until you say so.
• Adjust it yourself. Shorten the session, lighten it, move it home, skip a movement or swap one out.
• A movement guide with real photos. Each exercise shows a real person through the movement, with cues, the muscles it works, and how to scale it.
• Log food fast. Search, scan a barcode, snap a meal or say what you ate, and see calories and macros against a target built from your body.
• Apple Watch. See the set you are on, log it from the wrist, and count the rest.
• A partner. Share a code and see each other's sessions, weekly progress and streaks.
• Streaks by the week, not the day. Meet your weekly target and the streak grows.

BUILT FOR SHOWING UP

No feed, no leaderboard, no ads. Korean and English, light and dark, and it follows the text size you set on your phone. Health data is used only to coach you and is never sold or used for advertising.

SUBSCRIPTION

AWOD Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: $24.99 per month or $149.99 per year (US prices; local prices may vary). New subscribers get a 3-day free trial that includes 30 minutes of voice coaching. Pro includes up to 300 minutes of live voice coaching per month under fair use. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Terms: https://www.awod.website/terms · Privacy: https://www.awod.website/privacy

record.description_evidence:
StrideAI is your AI fitness coach in your pocket. Built around your goal, your level, and the equipment you actually own — bodyweight, dumbbells, full gym, anything in between.

Every workout is generated fresh by Google Gemini. No two sessions look the same. Exercises, sets, reps, rest, technique notes — all tuned to you. Check off each move as you go, finish with one tap.

WHAT YOU GET

- AI workout generation — a new session in seconds, never repeats
- Built-in progress dashboard — streak counter, 12-week calendar heatmap, weight trend, workout frequency chart
- Weekly AI insights — every Monday morning, a short reflection on your last seven days with 1-3 specific recommendations for the next week
- Rest days that count — log a rest day with one tap, your streak stays intact
- Smart equipment matching — tell us what you have once, every workout respects it
- Learn the methodology — curated articles from Stronger by Science, ACE Fitness, Mayo Clinic, CDC, and NSCA

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

- Anonymous device ID (SHA-256 hash of your device identifier) — no signup, no account, no email
- Workout prompts go through our own secure backend, never directly to a third-party AI
- No ads, no tracking SDKs, no AppsFlyer/Facebook
- Full data deletion on request: privacy@fitnessaiapp.com

HOW WE STAY FREE

As an Amazon Associate, StrideAI earns from qualifying purchases. When an AI workout suggests gear you don't own — dumbbells, resistance bands, a yoga mat — you'll see optional links to Amazon. If you buy through them, Amazon shares a small commission with us at no extra cost to you. We never know what you bought.

No paywall, no subscription tier, no premium upsells. The app stays fully free.

DISCLAIMER

StrideAI is informational. It is not medical advice, a personal trainer, or a substitute for licensed care. Consult a physician before starting any new exercise program, especially with pre-existing conditions.
